constructors.effect: Introduce or explicitly reference one of U,L,M; never supplies a medicinal or celestial name.
Supply intensity I; owner transfer is not implied.
Supply basis B for that owner and property.
Supply t0,t1 with t0<t1; same pair retained within an explicit profile.
Bind one physical owner to intensity on that basis and time pair; all inputs must be written or separately paid in one exact whole compound.
CURRENT means I(owner,t1,B); TREND means I(owner,t1,B)-I(owner,t0,B). Both are world quantities, not codebook objects.
LOW compares current quantity with theta; HIGH is >=theta; RISING compares change with zero; FALLING with zero. Types do not interchange.

Apply matching value to field, yielding an actual world proposition about its profile. Same interface in exact licensed okaiin and qokaiin; pending field may await written value, never silently obtains one.
Assert the written proposition without claiming independent truth.
Conjoin predicates. A LOW_AND_RISING predicate requires identical owner, property, basis and times; otherwise only separate conjunction.
Make predicate an explicit condition for a written instruction; exact qokaiin extension may add this nonnull effect.
Direct observation of that same owner at t1 under the condition; consumes a real conditional predicate, not a symbolic report.

core_vocabulary.okaiin: Exact licensed CURRENT field plus aN; requires written profile and field value.
core_vocabulary.qokaiin: Exact licensed CURRENT field plus same aN; exact q whole residual also converts resulting predicate to a condition. No universal q rule.
core_vocabulary.dalg: LOW current-value hypothesis only, separately priced; no g negation.
core_vocabulary.ycheo: OBSERVE conditional instruction hypothesis; requires explicit owner and condition.
core_vocabulary.okol: Exact profile reference hypothesis; requires an already explicitly introduced profile, never binds owner by repetition alone.

reference_policy: Most recently explicitly constructed profile in the same complete native unit, unless a dictionary-fixed exact reference names an existing owner. Native units may open written profiles but line boundaries never do so automatically. Different rings may reuse intensity/basis/times as interfaces but owners U/L differ. No Moon-to-body causal transfer is licensed.
world_input_policy: No external measured world data is supplied or claimed. World variable I(owner,time,basis) is hypothetical; assertions/conditions are text hypotheses, not empirical facts. Numerical truth is intentionally unevaluated. Any later outside measurement requires explicit source and new registration.
dictionary_policy: Additional exact wholes may compose these twelve frozen families and reuse eight constants only, with each root/alias/compound/reference/default/residual charged. No new singleton action or opaque noun. No null parts, automatic uncertain-space joins, entity decoding or alternate-reader aliases. At first missing operand or unassigned raw whole retain UNKNOWN/BLOCKED; no repair of constructor families.
part_policy: Invoke shared aN only on exact licensed forms with actual field-value predication. okoaiin extra internal o is a separately paid exact trend extension. This makes no universal o/prefix grammar.
limitations: World predication construction is exploratory C0, not confirmed translation.
aN cannot have a nonnull predication effect unless written profile and compatible value are supplied.
Missing profile/value/consumer inputs produce partiality; no mechanical completeness target can erase those blocks.
Lower ring owner identity remains U/L opaque and both Sun-like/full-Moon alternatives remain unresolved.
